findings.message: The received file is a 1024x1536 PNG with SHA-256 460244df578008c5854279f0464e73b152969402726ed6012e2a2532866f7c96 and contains Arturo Salcedo only.

Layout and exclusions pass. Exactly six separated studies appear in the required two-column, three-row order with full crowns, chins, hands, and feet, and no borders, labels, station, car, umbrella, contracts, cigarette case, story action, readable text, logo, signature, watermark, or other character.

Identity and age presentation pass as a proposed supporting-character design. Arturo reads as a mature 41-year-old adult man with a tall lean build, pale-olive flat tone, slick black hair, angular cheekbones, controlled expressions, and a patient quietly threatening presence without villain caricature.

Wardrobe and hand continuity pass. The immaculate ivory linen suit remains mostly white paper with precise seams, paired with a dark tie, work-appropriate shoes, clearly constructed hands, and one distinct signet ring visible in the three-quarter business posture.

The printed-manga finish passes: clean variable ink contours, restrained flat tone, sparse hatching, small controlled blacks, crisp bust boundaries, matte materials, and no cinematic lighting, gloss, gradients, painterly rendering, photorealism, CGI, or 3D shading.

Visual approval is recommended, but Arturo's brief remains storyboard-conditional and no approved storyboard currently confirms that he appears rather than remaining in reported dialogue. Promotion must remain blocked until that condition is satisfied and the user gives explicit approval.

The exact executed image job was not supplied and the Downloads filename omits the planned version suffix. Future promotion must preserve the exact bytes under arturo-salcedo-reference-v001.png and bind that file by SHA-256.
No image was edited, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted. The Downloads original remains unchanged and a byte-identical copy is retained only as internal review evidence.
